name: riposte
description: Independent, deterministic verification for AI agent decisions and actions. PASS | FAIL | ABSTAIN, with replayable proofs and a signed receipt ledger.
author: Tucker Anderson

scripts.build: npm run build -w riposte-verify && npm run build -w riposte-ai && npm run build -w riposte-adapters
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w riposte-verify && npm run typecheck -w riposte-ai && npm run typecheck -w riposte-adapters
scripts.test: npm test -w riposte-verify && npm test -w riposte-ai && npm test -w riposte-adapters
